experiments.name: Weight decay
experiments.question: Does weight decay do at tiny scale what the literature says?
experiments.headline: Weight norm 5.562 → 5.418
experiments.detail: Validation loss 2.048 → 2.059. The direction was right; the size was smaller than predicted.

experiments.name: Muon vs AdamW
experiments.question: Does Muon beat AdamW under a matched tuning budget?
experiments.headline: Best validation loss 1.422 vs 1.984
experiments.detail: At width 128, Muon is 28.3% lower than AdamW. At width 64: 1.597 vs 2.057. The advantage is larger than predicted.

experiments.name: Multi-token prediction
experiments.question: Does an extra prediction head help or interfere with the main head?
experiments.headline: Main-head loss 2.059 → 2.050
experiments.detail: The MTP head's own loss is 2.583. The predicted gradient alignment failed badly.

experiments.name: MoE routing
experiments.question: Does sparse routing collapse, persist, or stay balanced?
experiments.headline: Router max share 0.399 → 0.263

experiments.name: Learning-rate tail
experiments.question: Does a cosine tail pay off more when gradient noise is high?
experiments.headline: Cosine tail 2.043 → 2.028
experiments.detail: Benefit +0.016 at width 16, −0.005 at 32, +0.006 at 8. The noise interaction was not supported.

experiments.name: Learned memory gating
experiments.question: Can a model learn when to trust a stale external memory?
experiments.headline: NEW-fact top-1 0.000 → 0.133
experiments.detail: OLD-fact top-1 falls from 1.000 to 0.083. The gate recovers updated facts by suppressing hints, not by clean selective trust.

experiments.name: Live-market probe
experiments.question: Does a walk-forward linear model find an edge after costs?
experiments.headline: Directional accuracy 49.0%
experiments.detail: MSE skill -3.2%; Sharpe after cost -0.149; volatility ACF(1) 0.358. No tradable linear edge.
